% Generated by manual/tools/gen_reference.py from TandemApp's code. Do not edit by hand.

\begin{reftable}{Every error status and type}{tab:ref-errors}{\hd{status, Retry-After} & \hd{error.type or code} & \hd{when}}
\texttt{400} & \texttt{invalid\_\allowbreak{}request\_\allowbreak{}error} & a request TandemApp will not relay as asked: error.param names the field \\
\texttt{400} & \texttt{bad\_\allowbreak{}request} & a dashboard, fleet or conductor query or body that does not parse (a level, a range, a number, a body that is not an object) \\
\texttt{400} & \texttt{model\_\allowbreak{}required} & a cache route through the gateway without the model that names the deployment \\
\texttt{400} & \texttt{context\_\allowbreak{}length\_\allowbreak{}exceeded} & a prompt and \texttt{max\_\allowbreak{}tokens} that no member of the deployment has the window for \\
\texttt{401} & \texttt{unauthorized} & a guarded route without the token or the session it needs, once an admin password is set; a wrong collect token \\
\texttt{401} & \texttt{invalid\_\allowbreak{}api\_\allowbreak{}key} & the proxy, once a user key exists: no key, or a key it does not know (code \texttt{invalid\_\allowbreak{}api\_\allowbreak{}key}) \\
\texttt{403} & \texttt{forbidden} & a memory route outside a known session address; a cross-site write; a weights copy with another token \\
\texttt{403} & \texttt{wrong\_\allowbreak{}password} & a change of the admin password whose current password (or admin token) is not right \\
\texttt{404} & \texttt{not\_\allowbreak{}found} & no such route, or a route whose part is off on this server (the conductor, the backends, the fleet) \\
\texttt{404} & \texttt{unsupported\_\allowbreak{}route} & the proxy: a route the backend's kind does not serve, such as embeddings on deepseek (code \texttt{unsupported\_\allowbreak{}route}) \\
\texttt{404} & \texttt{model\_\allowbreak{}not\_\allowbreak{}found} & a model id no backend serves, or one two backends serve (the message names the prefixed forms) (code \texttt{model\_\allowbreak{}not\_\allowbreak{}found}) \\
\texttt{405} & \texttt{method\_\allowbreak{}not\_\allowbreak{}allowed} & the admin password or the Setup Guide's relay with a method it does not take \\
\texttt{409} & \texttt{busy} & an Add Spark session or an install that already runs; a chatd job that runs on TandemNode \\
\texttt{409} & \texttt{closed}, \texttt{stale} & a package proposal already closed, or whose base text changed since \\
\texttt{409} & \texttt{conflict} & an Add Spark session in another state, a device picked twice, more devices than one add takes \\
\texttt{409} & \texttt{not\_\allowbreak{}a\_\allowbreak{}member} & X-Tandem-Pin names a node that is not a member of the deployment \\
\texttt{413} & \texttt{too\_\allowbreak{}large} & a request body over the limit (a fleet request's body over 4 MiB) \\
\texttt{422} & \texttt{invalid\_\allowbreak{}request\_\allowbreak{}error}, \texttt{invalid\_\allowbreak{}report} & a value the schema refuses: a config field (error.field), a field an environment variable locks (error.variable), a Laya, library or memory call's fields, an eval report \\
\texttt{422} & \texttt{schema}, \texttt{secret}, \texttt{cap}, \texttt{user}, \texttt{unknown\_\allowbreak{}id}, \texttt{unknown\_\allowbreak{}package}, \texttt{rule\_\allowbreak{}from\_\allowbreak{}tool}, \texttt{no\_\allowbreak{}session}, \texttt{no\_\allowbreak{}user}, \texttt{refused\_\allowbreak{}root}, \texttt{no\_\allowbreak{}proposals}, \texttt{propose} & a memory note or a package proposal refused, with the reason as the type: a field (schema), a secret, a cap, an unknown note or package \\
\texttt{429}\newline with \texttt{Retry-After} & \texttt{too\_\allowbreak{}many} & a fifth log or live stream at once; a sixth failed sign-in in a minute; too many wrong passwords or pairing attempts \\
\texttt{429}\newline with \texttt{Retry-After} & \texttt{rate\_\allowbreak{}limited} & the library, Laya or memory routes past their calls a minute \\
\texttt{500} & \texttt{internal\_\allowbreak{}error}, \texttt{error} & a bug, or a fleet job that failed on an exception: the message is the exception's \\
\texttt{502} & \texttt{connect\_\allowbreak{}error}, \texttt{upstream\_\allowbreak{}error}, \texttt{key\_\allowbreak{}unreadable} & the proxy could not reach the backend or read its stored key, after its retries \\
\texttt{502} & \texttt{unreachable} & Add Spark: a paired device whose agent does not answer, or answers with an error \\
\texttt{200} & \texttt{upstream\_\allowbreak{}closed}, \texttt{upstream\_\allowbreak{}error} & a stream that already began: the backend failed or closed early; the client gets an error event, then \texttt{[DONE]} \\
\texttt{503}\newline with \texttt{Retry-After} & \texttt{server\_\allowbreak{}busy} & a backend or a deployment that cannot take the request now; error.code says why (the codes below) \\
\texttt{503}\newline with \texttt{Retry-After} & \texttt{max\_\allowbreak{}inflight} & every backend for the model is at the \texttt{max\_\allowbreak{}inflight} you set (Retry-After: 1) \\
\texttt{503}\newline with \texttt{Retry-After} & \texttt{deployment\_\allowbreak{}stopped} & a request for a deployment that is stopped, or a Split without a plan \\
\texttt{503}\newline with \texttt{Retry-After} & \texttt{no\_\allowbreak{}member}, \texttt{member\_\allowbreak{}not\_\allowbreak{}serving} & a deployment with no member that takes requests now, or the pinned member does not \\
\texttt{503}\newline with \texttt{Retry-After} & \texttt{node\_\allowbreak{}draining} & a member whose node is drained for maintenance \\
\texttt{503}\newline with \texttt{Retry-After} & \texttt{not\_\allowbreak{}loaded} & a Laya call while the engine has handed over no decision model \\
\texttt{504} & \texttt{upstream\_\allowbreak{}timeout}, \texttt{timeout} & a backend that sent no first byte in time; a Laya call past its deadline \\
\end{reftable}
